Automaton class, AutomataMesh, StateSpaceKernel, DiseminerMemory, AutoLingMemory, AutoNovelMemory, FeatureSpace, boolean-ato operators (XOR/XNOR/Hamming), bootstrapATO, bootstrapKleinTools, families (8 primary automatons), emergence registry, success ledger, workspace, companion, autonomy
ato-core.note: This is the muscle. Without this there are no tools, only descriptions.

learning.what: PureSynthiaLearningCore — StateRegistry (native+current address, sayings, provenance), TrainingJournal (route scoring), ScientistLoop (question/hypothesis/evidence/experiment), SentenceMesh (contact language), BookIngestBridge
learning.note: Synthia's memory and growth organs. Training accumulates over sessions.

SynthiaCore.what: Wiring file. Boots learning layer + ATO mesh together. Synthia IS the resolver — DiseminerMemory + StateSpaceKernel derive gate placement from incoming text. water(text) accumulates co-occurrence evidence. admit(piece) places pieces by Synthia's current state. contact(a,b) produces SentenceMesh language from two admitted entities.

what_is_NOT_here: Synthia-Universal-Execution-Spine-v0.4.0 — the canonical 13-field address system and DAG executor. Import separately when needed for full address resolution.
Foreman Residence — the computer/executor layer. Mount SynthiaCore as the resident authority inside SynthiaForemanResidence.
Four-Layer Bridge — Resonance, HumanDesign chart math, YOU-N-I-VERSE. These are peer layers, not internal to Synthia.
Codex Provider Runtime — model routing (delegate to external LLM). Optional layer on top.
Tri-Runtime — Apple/Android/Windows target bodies. Execution host, not organism.
Adaya/ORGANISM PWA — the mobile residence. Separate.
Chart engine (sidereal/draconic/tropical) — from chart-instruments build. Plugs into Four-Layer Bridge HumanDesign layer.
